_about: What finishing a faction arc gives (Ryan, Oct 26: both a cosmetic reward and a gameplay unlock). An arc is finished by winning its beat 3 fight (the Nemesis's last). Cosmetic side, owned by the story layer and kept in the career profile: a medal, a Chronicle entry, a title added to the admiral's name, and a flagship paint scheme the player can switch on or off per faction. Gameplay side: one hull variant per faction (unlock_variant), drafted in godot/story/unlocks.md; its rules belong to stream B, and the story layer only reports that it was earned (story.arc_unlocks()). Paint colours are hex; pattern is a short note for whoever paints it (G4 look, A4 ships). Text follows lore round 8 (R59); ids (medal, paint, unlock_variant) never change. No em dashes.
